transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, September 17. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 100 percent tariffs on India? Russia sanctions bill passed by US House; awaits Trump's assent. The US House has successfully passed a sanctions bill aimed at Russian officials and the energy sector. This new legislation empowers President Trump to impose tariffs on significant buyers of Russian oil. India might encounter a staggering 100 percent tariff on its imports due to its energy dealings with Russia. The bill also broadens sanctions against Russia and prolongs measures against Iran for an additional five years. 'Very political': Trump fumes after 1st Fed rate hike in over 3 years. The Federal Reserve has set a new target range by increasing its benchmark interest rate, marking its first hike since 2023. President Donald Trump has called for a substantial reduction in interest rates, advocating for lower borrowing costs given the country's robust credit status. However, officials have stated that ongoing inflation remains a significant factor driving this adjustment. Good El Nino? How a bad monsoon left city drenched. Depression cheer, P 4 'God-gifted talent': Rashid Khan on Sooryavanshi's skill rarely seen at 15 Exclusive. Rashid Khan believes Afghanistan needs to find solutions in the powerplay, while India's fearless young batters have caught his eye. The Afghanistan star explains what makes Abhishek Sharma a 'very big package' for Team India and calls 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi a "God-gifted talent". Rashid also identifies Noor Ahmad and Abdollah Ahmadzai as players to watch and opens up about the one ICC achievement he still wants in his book. Why Mark Zuckerberg's wife's school was shut down despite $125 million in donations,. After ten years in operation, Priscilla Chan's Primary School in East Palo Alto has shut down. Supported by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, the school was designed to provide essential services for low-income families. However, despite substantial funding, student outcomes frequently lagged behind state benchmarks. As the initiative pivots towards scientific research, this closure illustrates the difficulties faced by philanthropic educational endeavors. 88 lakh diyas to light up Gujarat for PM Modi's birthday today. Amit Shah, Bhupendra Patel To Be Present For Main Event At Kankaria Lakefront Government lowers export levies on petrol, diesel and aviation turbine fuel. India's government has reduced export levies on petrol, diesel, and aviation fuel. The revised rates for these petroleum products took effect from September sixteenth. Export duty on petrol decreased by one rupee to zero point five rupees per litre. Diesel export levies were lowered by five rupees to twenty rupees per litre. 10-year-old saves baby sister from fire, earns bravery award. Ten-year-old Ollie Brunskill became a real-life hero after spotting a kitchen fire at his Tasmania home and alerting his mother. The boy, dressed as Link from The Legend of Zelda for Book Week, then rescued his baby sister, Nora. His quick thinking helped his family escape safely as flames engulfed the kitchen and spread rapidly. SC pulls up govt for 'denying' disabled soldiers their benefits. Quoting Raksha Mantri 2015 Report, which admitted that "many disabled soldiers in India are still denied disability benefits on hyper-technical reasons", Supreme Court has pulled up Centre and the defence ministry for litigating against them in all forums of the judiciary - from tribunals to HCs and SC. Elon Musk's Starlink mobile plan should be 'laughed out of the room', says T-Mobile CEO. T-Mobile's CFO Peter Osvaldik has raised concerns about the practicality of Starlink in the mobile sector, citing challenges posed by satellites in urban landscapes. He emphasizes the difficulties in deploying numerous small cell stations as envisioned by SpaceX. While Starlink aspires to bridge mobile service gaps in remote locations, T-Mobile sees significant obstacles in supplanting current cellular infrastructure, deeming it an uphill battle. Hospitals could be charging 2,841 percent higher on commonly used consumables. Maha FDA Chief Urges Centre To Address 'Permissible Gap' Rape convict Ram Rahim returns to Sunaria jail after 21-day furlough. Dera Sacha Sauda chief Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh returned to Rohtak's Sunaria jail on Wednesday after completing his 21-day furlough.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. EPF wage ceiling hike: Lesser take home salary for these employees; know how you will be impacted. In a significant update, the EPFO wage ceiling limit has been modified to rupees 25,000 monthly. This modification will add fifty-one lakh workers to the social security umbrella. With this change, both employee and employer contributions will go up from rupees 1800 to rupees 3000, potentially cutting monthly take-home pay by rupees 1200. End of free era for UPI: Here's what changes, what doesn't. Starting 15 Oct, UPI will introduce a capped merchant fee on transaction values above rupees 2,000, while remaining entirely free for consumers and most small vendors. The policy shift provides a sustainable revenue model to upgrade digital infrastructure and align UPI with global payment standards. Before handing over your flat for redevelopment, check these 6 safeguards. It is important for residents to complete their due diligence and secure adequate safeguards before handing over possession of the existing building to the builder Will this EPF insurance limit rise to rupees 10.50 lakh after EPF wage ceiling hike to rupees 25,000?. The government has approved raising the EPF wage ceiling to rupees 25,000. This change will significantly increase the Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance coverage amount. Nominees could receive a maximum assured sum of rupees 10.50 lakh or more. The revised ceiling aligns social security thresholds with current wage levels. Credit card EMI versus personal loan: Which costs less for big-ticket purchases?. A lower EMI does not necessarily mean a cheaper loan. Before choosing between a credit card EMI and a personal loan, calculate the total amount payable under both options. ITR filed under old tax regime by mistake, income tax paid under new regime: How a lady won case in ITAT Delhi. Filed ITR under the old tax regime but paid income tax under the new tax regime; ladywins case in ITAT Delhi after proving her accountant mistakenly filed this ITR under the old tax regime. M. Balaganesh, Accountant Member and Sudhir Kumar, Judicial Member of ITAT Delhi heard this case. UPI new rules from Oct 15: What happens to insurance, SIP payments? Will Netflix, phone bills via AutoPay get costlier?. New UPI rules effective October 15 introduce a 0.4 percent fee for merchant transactions above rupees 2,000. While some costs may rise for consumers, person-to-person transfers remain free. Subscriptions via UPI AutoPay won't incur additional charges, protecting users from unexpected increases. How much money can NRIs transfer from NRO to NRE account in a year?. Non-Resident Indians can effectively manage their Indian earnings via NRO accounts. They are allowed to transfer funds to NRE accounts, but there are specific regulations to follow. Should you choose zero copay for your health insurance? Why? Why not? Explained. A zero-copay health insurance policy reduces hospitalisation costs but often comes with higher premiums. It's crucial to compare coverage, premiums and potential expenses before selecting one. 70 percent think rupees 1 crore is enough for retirement; can it meet your retirement goal?. Is rupees 1 crore enough for retirement? A new study reveals declining confidence among urban Indians, with many accumulating only 28 percent of their target corpus. Retirement planning is shifting earlier, with a growing focus on health and personal passions. Discover what truly defines retirement readiness beyond just financial savings. rupees 3,000 Annapurna Yojana payout on September 17, PM Modi's birthday: Are you eligible to receive money? Check new rules. On September 17, Prime Minister Modi's birthday, rupees 3,000 will be credited to 1.58 crore eligible women under the Annapurna Yojana. 67 percent rise in EPS pension for these employees as wage ceiling hike to rupees 25,000 gets cabinet's approval. The central government has raised the provident fund wage ceiling to rupees 25,000 monthly, which will enhance social security coverage for many organised sector employees. Those earning this amount in basic pay and dearness allowance will now be included in the Employee Provident Fund and Employee Pension Scheme. This adjustment aims to broaden the reach of social security benefits, thus supporting a larger workforce in their retirement planning. EPFO wage ceiling raised to rupees 25,000: How much could your rupees 7L EPF insurance cover increase? Here's how to calculate. The Union Cabinet raised the EPFO wage ceiling from rupees 15,000 to rupees 25,000, potentially increasing the life insurance cover under the EDLI scheme from rupees 7 lakh to an estimated rupees 10.5 lakh. This change could benefit between 50 lakh and 1 crore new EPFO members. Elder sister revoked first Will favouring younger sister after property dispute; HC upheld the second Will giving the house to adopted daughter. After elder sister revoked her 1st Will, younger sister forcefully grabbed her house and refused her entry; elder sister writes a 2nd Will giving house to adopted daughter; Punjab and Haryana HC upholds this 2nd Will. An SLP has been filed against this high court judgement in Supreme Court. SC's decision is pending. Moving funds from NRO to NRE? Crucial tax rules and transfer limits you need to know. Transferring capital from an NRO account to an NRE account is fully permitted, but it remains strictly regulated by tax and foreign exchange rules. Gold hallmarking fee hiked by 67 percent : New BIS charges for gold and silver articles explained.
